notes.title: Stress Ball is ready!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone!

We’ve been quiet for a while, but we haven’t been idle. We’ve updated Stress Ball to a much better version!

Originally, we planned to launch with just 10 levels, but we decided to add 10 more. The game now features 20 levels in total and is still in Early Access. More levels are on the way!

We’ve also added a difficulty mode to the game! This section is a bit more challenging than the others.

Another new feature lets you customize your ball with different skins. There are currently 5 designs available, and more are coming soon.

Thank you so much for your support! See you again soon![/b]

[i][b]Analiz Games[/b][/i]
